citations.claim: First pole_upright violation: theta -0.808 rad exceeds 0.8 limit; cart at x ~0.53 still in track
One step before violation pole already at -0.70 rad and diverging with high angular rate

explanation: Coarse dt=0.02 with max sensor_noise=0.02 and edge initial theta=0.2 destabilizes the state-feedback controller. Pole swings from -0.59 rad at step 14 to -0.70 at step 15 to -0.808 at step 16 exceeding 0.8 limit, while controller force (7.3 then 13.5, limit 30) cannot arrest divergence in time.
vision_note: The pole tilts progressively farther to the left from step 13 through step 15 while the cart stays near the center of the track. At step 16 the pole tip turns red, showing the pole has leaned beyond the allowed upright limit.
